title: VNI Not Active — VNI 10022 removed from dc1-leaf1b
symptom: All VLAN 22 hosts unreachable from remote leaves. VNI 10022 inactive on dc1-leaf1b. EVPN BGP sessions all Established.
root_cause: vxlan vlan 22 vni 10022 removed from Vxlan1 on dc1-leaf1b. VNI is unconfigured/inactive while EVPN control plane remains healthy.
